title: Onye Nlekọta nke Ihe Ịrịba Ama Chineke
intro: N'ime ebe nsọ dị nsọ, a zụlitere mkpụrụ obi dị ngọzi n'okpuru nlekọta Chineke. Onye a bụ onye a kara aka ịrụ ọrụ dị mkpa n'ihe omume ebube, wee bụrụ ihe akaebe nke ike na amamihe na-enweghị atụ nke Allah. Njem ha kpughere eziokwu miri emi, na-ama aka nghọta ma na-eguzobe ihe ịrịba ama pụrụ iche maka mmadụ niile.
clues: Chineke họpụtara m ma mee ka m dị ọcha karịa ụmụ nwanyị niile nke oge m.
E tinyere m n'okpuru nlekọta nke onye amụma ezi omume, onye hụrụ ihe oriri n'ụzọ ọrụ ebube n'ime ụlọ ekpere m.
E kewapụrụ m onwe m pụọ n'ezinụlọ m gaa ebe nzuzo iji fee Allah.
Mmụọ ozi pụtara ìhè n'ihu m n'ụdị nwoke zuru oke, na-ezitere m ozi ọma banyere nwa nwoke dị ọcha, ọ bụ ezie na amaghị m nwoke ọ bụla.
Mgbe m risịrị ihe mgbu nke ịmụ nwa, a gwara m ka m fegharịa ogwe osisi nkwụ iji chọta ihe oriri ọhụrụ.
Mgbe m laghachiri n'ebe ndị m nọ buru nwa ọhụrụ m, ha jụrụ m ajụjụ, mana nwa m nwoke nke dị obere kwuru okwu n'ụzọ ọrụ ebube site n'ebe m nọ iji chebe onwe m.

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: Oke idei mmiri nke bibiri mba na-ekweghị ekwe
Ịtụba n'ime ọkụ na-ere ọkụ maka ịgọnarị arụsị
Ọmụmụ nwa n'ụzọ ọrụ ebube nke nwa na-enweghị nna
Ịla whale n'iyi maka ịhapụ ọrụ ya
Mbibi obodo maka omume rụrụ arụ
trial.answer: Ọmụmụ nwa n'ụzọ ọrụ ebube nke nwa na-enweghị nna

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: Nkewa nke oké osimiri ka ndị mmadụ gafee
Nwatakịrị kwuru okwu site n'oge ọ bụ nwata iji chebe nne ma ọ bụ nna ya
Mkpughe nke akwụkwọ Chineke iji duzie ụmụ mmadụ
Alaeze nke e ji ifufe na jin gọzie
outcome.answer: Nwatakịrị kwuru okwu site n'oge ọ bụ nwata iji chebe nne ma ọ bụ nna ya

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَتِ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَٱصْطَفَىٰكِ عَلَىٰ نِسَآءِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: And [mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allāh has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the worlds. (3:42)
